summary: An additional immutable structured review event published during this session contains top-level slotId, which main's current validate_event allowed-key schema rejects. Recovery must compatibly accept and strictly validate this already-published review field as well as the previously reported pr/headSha/verdict fields; the historical event cannot be rewritten or deleted.
evidence: Current main validate_event compatibility described by evt-20260811-080800-r8v2c6-event-schema-blocker allows laneId/severity/evidence/toWorker/metadata beyond the required event fields; slotId is not in that allowed set.
Current transition_check forbids changing or deleting already-published event bytes, so repairing the historical event itself would violate the immutable-event fence.

The valid recovery is to extend event compatibility with strict slotId type/shape validation and regression coverage, or otherwise make the validator accept the immutable historical schema without weakening fail-closed checks.

metadata.recommendedRecovery: extend validate_event compatibility for immutable structured review slotId with strict string validation and regression coverage
